answer: Anchor each identity to a small wind turbine at the edge of a registered island orchard. Each epoch its meter signs a fresh generation curve: a passing gale leaves a gust signature no two sites share, cross-checked against nearby public weather stations. One turbine, one vote: a hundred puppets sharing one turbine report the same curve and collapse to one ballot, and replaying last epoch's curve dies on the fresh nonce. Forging a hundred votes means buying and running a hundred real turbines on a hundred different islands, while an honest holder just lets the wind work once per epoch.
